environmentClassification.shopify: owner-designated non-production test environment; paid plan is not an environment classifier
environmentClassification.firebase: owner-provided development project plus isolated no-cost staging project; production is intentionally absent

gates.name: Phase 1 integrity and SDK correction
gates.proven: Preparation integrity and the API 36/JDK 17 baseline.

gates.name: Reproducible native Android scaffold
gates.proven: Pinned modular native scaffold, variants, local quality lanes, app/test APKs, and 27 current physical connected tests.
gates.unproven: The historical AVD does not boot; no required claim relies on it.

gates.name: Configuration, brand, environment, security, observability
gates.proven: Fail-closed typed environment/brand configuration, localization, redaction, Keystore, URI, consent, and disabled telemetry boundaries.
gates.unproven: Production identity/signing/assets/legal links and final consent policy are later product/release decisions.

gates.name: Typed Shopify Storefront and Apollo proof
gates.proven: Current typed operations, owned cart lifecycle, physical Keystore restore/failure, cleanup, and checkout URL handoff.
gates.unproven: Full product cart UX is Phase 3.

gates.name: Customer Account OAuth 2.0 and PKCE proof
gates.proven: Owned Public Mobile configuration, physical system-browser callback/PKCE, exact exchange/refresh, typed identity, Keystore restore, and logout.
gates.unproven: Production callback/signing and full product account UX are outside Phase 2.

gates.name: Cart to official Checkout Kit proof
gates.proven: Physical preload/render/cancel/complete/restore, Bogus approval and decline with no false completion, cart cleanup/retention, and read-only Admin test-order reconciliation.
gates.unproven: Full product checkout UX, exhaustive offsite providers, and production payments are outside this foundation gate.

gates.name: Project-owned Firebase development and staging proof
gates.proven: Two isolated projects/four apps, variant consumption, physical dev/staging initialization with auto-init disabled, explicit permission and Installation ID registration, one controlled synthetic delivery, allowlisted tap navigation, Remote Config fetch/activate, unregister and temporary-target cleanup, current connected suites, and absent Analytics/Crashlytics SDKs.
gates.unproven: Production Firebase, production push, notification campaigns, Analytics/Crashlytics, billing, backend, and data products are intentionally outside the Phase 2 foundation.

gates.name: Product acceptance pack for 24 candidate groups
gates.proven: All 24 candidates have product/security/state/test recommendations and explicit unknowns.
gates.unproven: PASS covers the decision pack, not feature implementation.
